entities.summary: Schrammelmusik is a style of Viennese folk music originating in the late nineteenth century and still performed in Austria. The style is named for the prolific folk composers Johann and Josef Schrammel. Schrammelmusik is a music genre. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
